title: Orange-on-dark global theme with red accents

requirements.summary: Shift global theme tokens to an orange-forward palette with near-black backgrounds for strong contrast in both default and dark themes.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/index.css, the CSS variables for --background/--card/--popover in .dark use a near-black / black-alternative background (not a brown/green-tinted dark), while maintaining readable --foreground contrast.
The primary color token remains clearly orange-forward (buttons/links that use primary read as orange across the app).
No changes are made to any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

file_operations.description: Update :root and .dark CSS variable tokens to use a near-black neutral background/card/popover (no warm/green tint), keep high-contrast foregrounds, and ensure --primary remains clearly orange-forward. Also adjust supporting tokens (muted/border/input/ring/secondary/chart) as needed to preserve legibility on dark surfaces. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align Tailwind theme color bindings with the CSS variable color format used in frontend/src/index.css so utilities like bg-background/text-foreground/text-primary render correctly after the token changes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Replace the existing green/forest accent token with a red accent and propagate it through gradients and decorative accent usage without replacing primary orange.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/index.css, --accent and --accent-foreground are updated to a red-accent pair in both :root and .dark.
Brand wordmark gradient styling in frontend/src/index.css uses the updated red accent (via the accent color or updated stop values) so it no longer trends green.
Any existing UI areas using accent token (e.g., Landing page gradient sections using from-primary/... to-accent/...) render with a red-tinted accent rather than green.

file_operations.description: Replace --accent/--accent-foreground in :root and .dark with a red accent pair; update brand-wordmark gradient stops so the final stop uses the new red accent (or references the accent token) and no longer trends green. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

If needed after the token swap, fine-tune wordmark/logo classes to ensure the updated red accent is strictly decorative (wordmark gradient) while primary UI actions remain orange-forward. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Audit and adjust page-level backgrounds/overlays so orange primary remains readable on near-black backgrounds and accent/gradient fills don’t muddy contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary CTA buttons and key highlights remain clearly visible and readable on dark/near-black backgrounds across the header, footer, and the landing hero/CTA sections.
Muted/background section fills (e.g., bg-muted/30, gradients) do not wash out orange primary or create muddy contrast in dark mode.
No new user-facing copy is introduced as part of the styling adjustments.

file_operations.description: Adjust hero/overview/how-it-works/CTA section background utility classes (gradients and muted fills) to better complement the new near-black theme, keeping orange primary CTAs/highlights crisp and avoiding washed-out or muddy overlays in dark mode; do not change copy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and adjust header/footer container background, translucency, and muted section fills so navigation links and primary highlights remain readable on near-black backgrounds (especially dark mode), without changing any user-facing copy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust page-level hero gradient and muted section background utilities to avoid low-contrast/muddy sections under the updated near-black + orange/red palette; do not change copy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust page-level hero gradient and muted section background utilities to keep headings/CTAs readable and ensure accent/outline styling remains harmonious on near-black backgrounds; do not change copy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust page-level hero gradient and prose container contrast (background utilities only) so long-form text remains readable on near-black backgrounds; do not change copy. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
